argument: As a rendered artifact chapter 15 mostly holds up: its tables do not clip, all 37 adventuring-gear rows arrive with their Notes intact, continuation pages repeat the column header, and the orphan-heading scan still reports exactly two across 365 pages (neither here). The defect is page flow. Two hand-placed pagebreaks strand content: the built PDF's page 235 carries a single callout with roughly 93% of the text frame blank, and page 228 stops near mid-page with its lower half empty. Both breaks also produce dead white immediately before a section start. The chapter introduces no new orphaned heading and no clipped cell, but a page holding one box is not a page.

evidence.claim: Word bounding boxes on built-PDF page 235 end at yMax=110pt inside the ~68-715pt text frame, about 6.6% fill; the running head and folio were excluded.
The Starting Gear callout is written after the gear table and the Coins paragraph, and a hard pagebreak follows it, so the box spills onto its own page and Mounts & Vehicles begins on the next one.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: New heroes take their class's starting kit

evidence.claim: A hard pagebreak after the shields paragraph closes the Armor section; the built page stops at yMax=383pt, so the lower half is blank before Encumbrance starts.

The table-fidelity gate reports 1 of 67 row tails not intact in the PDF, naming the gear table's longest item; its name is too wide for the 23.08% Item column and wraps to a second line, though vision confirms no clipping.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: row NAME missing: Volatile Reagents (alchemist's fire)

evidence.claim: Orphan-heading scan over the 365-page build still reports two headings last on a page, on p92 and p125, so chapter 15 adds none; the book-wide count stays at 2.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: 2 heading(s) sit last on a page

evidence.claim: All 37 gear rows render across pp230-234, the column header repeats at the top of each continuation page, and the weapons, armor and charge tables stay unsplit on one page each.
The vehicles table splits across pp238-239 so its final Warship row sits alone under a repeated header at the top of p239.
The Encumbrance figure caption carries a stray trailing comma that the chapter-opener caption does not, a small caption-typography inconsistency.
